data_output.description: The fixed training command must write predictions_valid.npz containing exactly two arrays: row_ids and scores. row_ids must be int64 identifiers in canonical validation row order, equal to np.arange(len(validation_rows)); scores must be a one-dimensional finite array with exactly one prediction per validation row and no additional output arrays.

model_input.description: The trainer receives encoded train and validation features produced by data.py, with each row represented by user and video indices in canonical split order. The model interface remains Model(dimension, learning_rate, l2), with step(features, labels) for BCE updates and predict(features) returning one score per input row.
